_README: Editorial ledger for FrontBrief.AI. The routine APPENDS one entry per run (newest last) and READS it to enforce two rules: (1) no repeat STORY within 5 days, (2) no repeat poster SHAPE back-to-back. 'shape' vocabulary: model-launch, model-ban/policy, money, m&a, benchmark, person-drama, research, compute, product, regulation. The poster pick is engagement-first and MAY differ from the article lead.
